blurb: Backroads Whistler operates exclusively in lake rentals and guided or self-guided tours down the River of Golden Dreams. They offer a variety of boats suitable for all ages and skill levels, including canoes, kayaks, paddleboards, and pedal boats. The River of Golden Dreams trip is a 3-hour round trip with 2 to 2.5 hours on the water, starting on Alta Lake and then down the river with a shuttle back at the end.
extraNote: Unguided trips go rain or shine; cancellations before departure are fully refundable; cancellations inside 24 hours have conditions · Guided guests must cancel before departure; cancellations inside 7 days have conditions · Groups of 10 or more must cancel before departure for full refund · Lakeside Park on Alta Lake · May to June 15th and September 2nd to October for multi-day rentals; field trips from late April to mid-October
